stories.title: Drone attacks sink a cargo ship off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, leaving 11 sailors missing
stories.reason: Prime Minister Radev called the strikes on two commercial vessels 'absolutely unacceptable' and summoned Russia's ambassador, while a second ship with 15 crew was rescued intact and EU Commission President von der Leyen condemned the attack.

stories.title: A man stabs at least eight people at a shopping mall in Incheon, South Korea
stories.reason: Bystanders subdued the 59-year-old suspect, a past attempted-murder convict who had been on electronic monitoring since 2019, after he moved through several floors attacking shoppers, leaving one woman in cardiac arrest and prompting President Lee to demand a swift investigation.

stories.title: JPMorgan posts a rare earnings miss while Goldman Sachs beats as Wall Street's big banks kick off Q3 results
stories.reason: JPMorgan's $5.57-a-share profit fell short of the $5.93 Wall Street expected even as it rose from a year earlier, while Goldman's equities revenue surged 72% and Wells Fargo stock fell 3%, with all four banks warning that higher rates and 'sticky inflation' could still bite.

stories.title: Elon Musk gives $276 million to Republican groups, becoming the 2026 midterms' biggest known donor
stories.reason: The bulk of the money, $158 million, went to the Senate Leadership Fund with another $76 million to his own America PAC, pushing his total federal giving this cycle to roughly $366 million and already surpassing his 2024 spending.

stories.title: France's navy intercepts a sanctioned Russian 'shadow fleet' tanker flying a false flag in the Indian Ocean
stories.reason: President Macron said forces boarded the tanker DF Peak, linked to sanctioned shipper Sovcomflot, roughly 450 nautical miles south of Reunion Island and escorted it in for inspection, part of a wider campaign that has already cut Moscow's false-flag shadow fleet by more than half since last October.

stories.title: UK Prime Minister Burnham says Iran's Revolutionary Guard was 'almost certainly' behind a plot against a US-used air base
stories.reason: Britain sanctioned two Iranians, including a senior IRGC counterespionage official, after police found gasoline in vans linked to suspects arrested near RAF Fairford, prompting the Pentagon to pull its bombers from the base as Iran denies any involvement and demands evidence.

stories.title: Apple's 'Welcome Home' event unveils a Siri-powered smart display, refreshed Apple TV and HomePod mini
stories.reason: The $299 HomeView display marks Apple's first dedicated smart-home hub and can recognize up to six household members, though like the refreshed Apple TV 4K and $149 HomePod mini 2, its Siri AI features won't be available in the EU or, in HomePod's case, until a later software update.

stories.title: A chip-stock selloff extends to a fifth straight day on fears the AI trade is overheating
stories.reason: Micron fell more than 5% as reports of advances by China's memory chipmaker CXMT added to a slide already rattling markets from Seoul to Wall Street, even as strong bank earnings kept the broader indexes only modestly lower.
